stability: own exposure response: neutral axis, white endpoint, monotone lightness, bounded chroma growth and curvature; no preferred hue
highlight_selection: RAW support invalid and corrected HNCS maximum display channel >0.6; colour fitting weight remains zero
solver: analytic joint L-BFGS-B, fixed-native sparse grid polish, exact integer coordinate descent
reproduction_scope: Historical objective configuration. Private RAWs, clipping masks, seven calibration states and initial checkpoint are not distributed; a new dataset does not imply the identical fitted coefficients.
style_preference: Subjective selection: natural-looking greens/blues and less objectionable yellow cast. No separate hard-coded green/blue/yellow correction was added to the released Look.
